Another NEET Exam Student Commits Suicide

A student who failed the NEET exam has committed suicide in Himachal Pradesh, highlighting the pressure and stress faced by students preparing for the exam. The incident is part of a growing concern about the impact of the NEET exam on students' mental health. The government has been criticized for not doing enough to address this issue.
